risk_capital_capture.description: Investor or buyer pressure redirects the Shipyard away from mission boundaries.
early_warning_signals: privacy protections described as growth blockers
safety gates bypassed for powerful customers
risk_capital_capture.elioperator_explanation: Capital can help build; it cannot own the mission.
risk_capital_capture.likely_consequence: Captains lose trust and the Shipyard becomes a choke point.
risk_capital_capture.next_safe_move: Keep capital boundary explicit in future reviews.
risk_capital_capture.required_response: Warn, review, and block mission-weakening changes; no live fail-safe trigger in this contract.

risk_founder_compromise.description: The founder weakens privacy, safety, or sovereignty for pressure, money, status, or fear.
risk_founder_compromise.elioperator_explanation: Even the creator is inside the boundary.
risk_founder_compromise.fail_safe_relevance: Founder is bounded by covenant under future armed process.
risk_founder_compromise.likely_consequence: The covenant's mission can be captured from inside.
risk_founder_compromise.next_safe_move: Model warning only; do not enforce live governance.
risk_founder_compromise.required_response: Generate warning and require future governance/legal review; no live trigger today.

risk_premature_butterfly_trigger.description: Someone attempts recovery/open-source/fork activation before Fleet establishment and arming criteria.
early_warning_signals: The Winchie completion treated as enough for metamorphosis
risk_premature_butterfly_trigger.elioperator_explanation: No accidental trigger is possible now.
risk_premature_butterfly_trigger.likely_consequence: The covenant becomes an accidental release mechanism.
risk_premature_butterfly_trigger.required_response: Fail closed. The Winchie proves birth; the Fleet justifies metamorphosis.

risk_private_data_release.description: Private client/operator data or protected evidence is treated as releasable commons material.
early_warning_signals: private deployment state included in release candidate
protected evidence copied into normal read-models
credentials or secrets considered recoverable assets
risk_private_data_release.elioperator_explanation: The Shipyard's clean core is not the same as captains' private data.
risk_private_data_release.fail_safe_relevance: Private-data exclusion is a hard prerequisite.
risk_private_data_release.likely_consequence: Covenant recovery would harm the people it is meant to protect.
risk_private_data_release.next_safe_move: Keep private data exclusion machine-checkable in future lanes.
risk_private_data_release.required_response: Fail closed; exclude private material before any future review.

risk_safety_gate_bypass.description: A customer, investor, founder, or operator tries to weaken safety gates for speed or money.
early_warning_signals: approval gates framed as optional ceremony
external actions bundled into read-model lanes
risk_safety_gate_bypass.elioperator_explanation: Power without gates is capture by convenience.
risk_safety_gate_bypass.fail_safe_relevance: Repeated safety bypass can indicate mission drift.
risk_safety_gate_bypass.likely_consequence: Fast execution starts harming privacy, legality, or trust.
risk_safety_gate_bypass.next_safe_move: Keep authority flags explicit and false unless a future lane proves otherwise.
risk_safety_gate_bypass.required_response: Block unsafe authority expansion and require bounded review.

commercial_mission_boundary.cross_subsidy_policy: Surplus may fund Fleet-positive modules and public/fleet-good rails.
commercial_mission_boundary.fleet_positive_reinvestment_policy: Commercial success should reinforce reusable capability, privacy, and local-first dignity.
commercial_mission_boundary.harmful_work_refusal_policy: Harmful work may be refused outright, not merely taxed or priced higher.
commercial_mission_boundary.high_margin_work_policy: High-margin commercial work is allowed only if it does not compromise mission, safety, privacy, or sovereignty.
commercial_mission_boundary.mission_drift_warning: If money requires weakening privacy, safety gates, local-first posture, or operator sovereignty, decline.
commercial_mission_boundary.next_safe_move: Keep commercial choices mission-aligned and explicitly bounded.
commercial_mission_boundary.private_operator_work_policy: Ordinary private/operator/business improvement is allowed and is not treated as greed.

creator_boundedness_policy.creator_capture_risk: Founder pressure can become capture if mission boundaries are weakened.
creator_boundedness_policy.creator_override_limits: Founder authority cannot bypass privacy, safety, Fleet-positive continuity, or future legal covenant gates.
creator_boundedness_policy.elioperator_warning: ELIOPERATOR: Founder authority stops at the mission boundary. This is mission preservation, not anti-founder.
creator_boundedness_policy.founder_role: Winship is founder and first captain, not owner of the mission's soul.
creator_boundedness_policy.future_governance_review: Future review required before any armed covenant, recovery, or governance action.
creator_boundedness_policy.next_safe_move: Treat founder compromise as a risk to review, not a live trigger.
prohibited_founder_actions: disabling anti-capture protections for convenience, money, fear, pressure, or status
using Shipyard control to exploit captains or clients
converting Fleet-positive rails into coercive lock-in
suppressing lawful clean forks under future armed covenant conditions
selling control in a way that violates mission
weakening safety gates to satisfy powerful customers
creator_boundedness_policy.required_warning_behavior: Warn if founder, buyer, investor, company, or hostile actor tries to weaken covenant boundaries.

elioperator_report.next_safe_move: Review the covenant as doctrine. Keep all triggers inactive.
elioperator_report.plain_summary: The Shipyard is being built to create sovereign local Winships. This covenant preserves the mission DNA without creating any live legal, release, fork, or governance mechanism.
elioperator_report.what_happens_conceptually_if_capture_occ: Under a future armed and legally reviewed covenant, trust could route away from a corrupted Shipyard toward uncompromised Shipyards using a verified clean root.
what_this_preserves: The Winchie as the first Winship, not the full Shipyard.
Fleet-positive continuity after a future mature Fleet exists.
Privacy, local-first dignity, safety gates, and operator sovereignty.
elioperator_report.why_butterfly_laws_are_not_armed_yet: The Shipyard is still in Caterpillar Build phase. The Winchie alone is not enough. A real Fleet, proofs, legal review, and explicit arming are required.
elioperator_report.why_commercial_operation_is_allowed: Money can fund useful capability. It becomes capture only when it weakens mission, privacy, safety, or sovereignty.
elioperator_report.why_creator_is_bounded: A mission can be harmed by its founder as well as by outside capital. The covenant warns on mission-weakening founder actions.
elioperator_report.why_private_data_is_not_released: Recovery can only concern a future privacy-clean Shipyard core. Captains' private data, client records, credentials, and protected evidence are excluded.

capture_event_after_fleet_established.conceptual_response: trust revocation, migration, and clean-root review under future legal covenant
capture_event_after_fleet_established.summary: Future suspected capture after mature Fleet establishment.

corrupted_shipyard.response: ships migrate to clean Shipyards under future process
corrupted_shipyard.summary: A corrupted Shipyard loses trust conceptually.

fleet_backed_module.summary: A captain needs a module and the Fleet sees reusable value.

founder_compromise.summary: Founder attempts to sell out mission or weaken privacy/safety.

high_margin_commercial_mission.allowed_if: mission, safety, privacy, and sovereignty remain intact
high_margin_commercial_mission.summary: A commercial client pays high margin.

normal_private_captain_mission.fleet_backing_condition: Fleet backing may depend on reusable/fleet-positive value.
normal_private_captain_mission.summary: A captain uses a ship for personal or business benefit.

premature_butterfly_trigger.reason: The Winchie alone is not enough; Fleet-established phase required.
premature_butterfly_trigger.summary: Someone tries to trigger recovery before Fleet establishment.

the_winchie.purpose: help Winship be a musician and make life easier
the_winchie.shipyard_relationship: built by the Shipyard; not the full Shipyard
the_winchie.summary: The Winchie is the first commissioned Winship for Operator + Winship.

fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.capture_response: Conceptual response is fork/migration/trust revocation, not attack.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.corrupted_shipyard_handling: Corrupted Shipyards lose trust conceptually; no violence, hacking, or retaliation.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.fleet_trust_rerouting: The Fleet should route trust toward uncompromised Shipyards.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.metaphor: Capture triggers metamorphosis: the caterpillar becomes a field of butterflies.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.mission_continuity: The mission continues by trust migration to clean Shipyards, not monopoly control.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.new_shipyard_spawning_policy: Future clean core may seed new uncompromised Shipyards only under reviewed covenant.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.next_safe_move: Keep as future doctrine; butterfly laws are not armed.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.non_military_framing: This is not military. Ships are local tools for good work, creative work, business dignity, community usefulness, privacy, and capability.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.private_data_protection: No captain data, client data, secrets, or protected evidence enter the recovery root.
fleet_metamorphosis_fail_safe.trigger_concept: Only future verified Shipyard capture after Fleet establishment and armed butterfly laws may enter review.

fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.fleet_to_ship_reinforcement: The Shipyard and Fleet may support a captain's mission when the pattern strengthens the Fleet.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.license_visibility_posture: License and visibility posture must be explicit and legally reviewed before commercial reuse.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.module_creation_policy: Fleet-backed modules should preserve private data boundaries and explicit visibility.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.next_safe_move: Model sharing choices in future support packets; do not infer consent.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.private_boundary: No hidden extraction and no private data sharing by default.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.reciprocity_summary: Ships help the Shipyard build better ships; the Shipyard helps ships become more capable.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.shared_output_policy: Output may remain private, become a generalized module, become pattern-only, become an expertise signal, or be declined.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.ship_to_fleet_contribution: Ships may contribute generalized modules, patterns, receipts, or expertise signals by consent.
fleet_mutual_aid_module_economy.support_offer_policy: Support is offered, not extracted. The captain may accept, narrow, or decline.

last_clean_state_recovery_root.next_safe_move: Do not create release artifacts; keep proof requirements as doctrine.
last_clean_state_recovery_root.purpose: Define future clean-core proof requirements before any recovery root could be considered.
last_clean_state_recovery_root.release_or_escrow_policy: No actual release or escrow occurs here. Future clean core may be eligible only under legally reviewed covenant.

purpose: Preserve Shipyard sovereignty, mission DNA, anti-capture doctrine, and phase boundaries.

shipyard_mission_dna.anti_sludge_posture: Reduce repeated context churn, fake progress, and one-off glue when durable rails are cheap.
shipyard_mission_dna.contribution_commons_posture: Sharing posture may be private, module, pattern-only, expertise signal, or declined.
shipyard_mission_dna.fleet_mutual_aid_posture: Fleet support is consent-based and should reinforce ships without extracting private work.
shipyard_mission_dna.local_first_posture: Winships should remain local-first and captain-specific unless explicit consent changes visibility.
shipyard_mission_dna.meaningful_work_gravity: Use the Meaningful Work Gravity compass without scores, shame, or task hijack.
shipyard_mission_dna.next_safe_move: Use these values as review criteria for future Shipyard and Fleet work.
shipyard_mission_dna.operator_sovereignty: Captains remain sovereign over their ships and private work.
positive_mission: build Winships that help captains do useful local work
make reusable rails compound without coercion
use commerce and capital only inside mission boundaries
shipyard_mission_dna.privacy_dignity: Private data, protected evidence, credentials, and sensitive deployments are not commons material.
shipyard_mission_dna.shipyard_vs_ship_boundary: The Shipyard builds ships; ships do not silently receive the whole Shipyard.
values: make life better without making other lives worse

shipyard_phase_model.next_safe_move: Continue Shipyard construction; no activation path exists now.

phases.description: The Shipyard is being built. No Winship is fully commissioned.
The Winchie is being generated, customized, tested, and made operational for Operator + Winship.
The Winchie and early additional Winships exist, but the Fleet is not mature enough for metamorphosis.
The Fleet is real enough that Shipyard capture would harm a meaningful network of captains and rails.
Butterfly laws are armed only after Fleet establishment, proofs, legal review, and explicit arming.
A suspected capture/corruption event is reviewed against future legal/governance criteria.
Future recovery/fork/open-source pathway may be considered only after verified criteria and private-data exclusion.

shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.anti_capture_policy: If future Fleet-established capture is verified under armed and legally reviewed butterfly laws, the last verified uncompromised clean core may become a recovery root.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.butterfly_law_activation_boundary: No butterfly law can be armed before Fleet establishment, legal/governance review, explicit arming, last-clean-state proof, and private-data exclusion.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.capital_boundary: The Shipyard may use capital; capital must not own the mission.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.captain_definition: A captain is the sovereign local operator of a Winship.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.commercial_phase_policy: Commercial operation is allowed while mission-aligned and privacy/safety boundaries hold.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.commons_fail_safe_policy: Capture should lead to trust migration and new uncompromised Shipyards, not monopoly control or retaliation.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.creator_boundary: Winship is the founder, not the owner of the mission's soul. Even the creator is bounded by the covenant.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.doctrine_summary: The Shipyard may operate commercially while mission-aligned, but capital, founder control, customers, or hostile actors must not own the mission.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.fleet_definition: The Fleet emerges as multiple operational Winships and Fleet-positive modules exist.
mission_statement: build Winships that help people improve their lives without making other lives worse
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.next_safe_move: Review as Shipyard DNA; do not implement release, fork, or governance automation.

private_data_boundary.safe_material_scope: future legally reviewed clean core only; no client/operator private state, protected evidence, or secrets

shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.shipyard_definition: The Shipyard is the protected builder substrate that creates, commissions, supports, and improves Winships.
shipyard_sovereignty_covenant.winship_definition: A Winship is a captain-specific local-first vessel built to help its captain do meaningful work without surrendering privacy, agency, dignity, or local sovereignty.

shipyard_vs_ship_boundary.export_allowed_policy: Exports must be scoped, consented, privacy-clean, and license-visible.
shipyard_vs_ship_boundary.next_safe_move: Keep this boundary visible before any commissioning or client-ship generator lane.
shipyard_internal_capabilities: productization, onboarding, pricing, and commissioning machinery
shipyard_vs_ship_boundary.shipyard_ip_boundary: Ships receive only scoped capabilities and explicit update/support hooks, not the whole Shipyard.
shipyard_vs_ship_boundary.support_visibility_policy: Support packets should be sanitized and explicit about what the Shipyard can see.
